description: This is a Java class providing custom assertion utilities for testing purposes, specifically for testing persistence of 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for asserting list contents with detailed error reporting and retry mechanisms for flaky assertions.

classes.name: Assertions
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for assertion and retry logic in testing scenarios.

methods.name: assertListWithIndexInfo
methods.description: Asserts list content by applying a provided BiConsumer for each element, with detailed error messages including index and element info.

methods.name: retryOnAssertionError
methods.description: Retries a given Runnable containing assertions until it succeeds or a timeout occurs, with configurable delays.
